items.title: Ransomware attack knocks IDC Frontier's IDCF Cloud offline, disrupting 495 customers
items.summary: IDC Frontier, a SoftBank subsidiary, confirmed on October 7 that a ransomware attack forced it to isolate its East Japan Region 1 data center in Fukushima. The company says 495 companies and local governments hold contracts tied to the affected region, and whether data was exfiltrated remains unconfirmed.

items.title: Citrix urges immediate patching of critical NetScaler flaw (CVE-2026-107406, CVSS 9.5)
items.summary: The memory-overflow vulnerability in NetScaler ADC and Gateway appliances configured as SAML SP/IdP can lead to remote code execution or denial of service. Patches are available, and Citrix says it knows of no active exploitation yet.

items.title: Splunk patches critical 9.8 flaw allowing unauthenticated remote command execution
items.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-76268 and disclosed October 7, the missing-authentication flaw in the Patroni REST API of Splunk Enterprise search head cluster members lets network-reachable attackers run OS commands with no login required.

items.title: Ransomware group BYOD claims Trump Mobile data breach, leaks records of 3,615 customers
items.summary: The RaaS operation says it stole names, email addresses, phone numbers, home addresses and order details after infecting a Liberty Mobile employee with an infostealer, and claims neither company used MFA. Neither company has publicly responded.

items.title: FBI seizes 7 domains, disrupts Flax Typhoon-linked hacking tools targeting critical infrastructure
items.summary: The court-authorized seizures denied China-linked Integrity Technology Group access to the Microscan and FishHub tools used against a South Carolina power company, airports in Japan and Poland, and Taiwanese energy organizations and universities. The agencies also issued a joint cybersecurity advisory.

items.title: Canadian ransomware negotiator arrested amid FBI hacker crackdown
items.summary: Edward Dubrovsky, who marketed threat-actor negotiation services via CyberSteward, was arrested Thursday on extortion-related conspiracy charges in the Eastern District of Pennsylvania as the FBI targets a group that stole information about its employees.
